episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Je-ha, a director with no future, meets terminally ill Da-eum while researching for his film.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Je-ha begins writing again. Da-eum reappears, not as a consultant this time — but as an actress.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Je-ha, a director with no future, meets terminally ill Da-eum while researching for his film.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Da-eum is left confused by Je-ha and Seo-young. Jung-woo invites them to an uncomfortable dinner.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Da-eum attempts to flee the hospital. But then, seeing someone in the elevator makes her freeze.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Je-ha turns Da-eum down. As their feelings grow complicated, Da-eum's first love, Eun-ho, reappears.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The first day of shooting is finally here. Je-ha feels uneasy watching Eun-ho lingering near Da-eum.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Da-eum reveals her illness to Seo-young. Tensions spill onto the set, where truth and fiction blur.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Je-ha finally confesses his feelings to Da-eum — and at last, the two confirm their love for each other. Je-ha, who once insisted there's no love in their film, begins rewriting the script. But then, a slanderous article by Noh breaks, with rumors of a scandal between Je-ha and Da-eum and accusations that the casting process was rigged. The public is in uproar, and cold stares follow Je-ha and Da-eum even on set. Unrelenting, Da-eum still gives it her all. Mr. Han threatens to pull his investments to pressure Seung-won. Je-ha suggests releasing Da-eum's audition video to win back the public's hearts, though Seung-won tells him to be patient, as it's not something that can be fixed overnight. But Je-ha snaps back: There is no time. Didn't he already know that Da-eum is terminally ill?

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Chaos erupts on set after a confession from Je-ha and Da-eum. Mr. Han orders Je-ha to be replaced.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Everyone returns to set to greet Je-ha and Da-eum with warmth. Now, it's time to convince the world.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Je-ha and Da-eum write a new ending for their movie. The final shoot of Love in White begins.
